items.t: Excessive oil consumption
items.job: Replace pistons and rings (or install a short block)
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $4,000. Toyota's ZE7 coverage has ended; a used engine can cost less.

items.t: Head bolt threads strip, causing coolant leaks
items.job: Install head bolt thread inserts and replace head gasket

items.t: Water pump leaking coolant
Check engine light from faulty VVT-i oil control valve
items.note: Includes basic code reading; an oil change may be needed too.

items.t: Side and curtain airbags may not inflate fully (recall)
Side airbags can go off when a door is slammed (recall)
Moonroof wind deflector glass can shatter (recall)
items.job: Apply protective laminate to deflector glass

items.t: Manual transmission grinds or shifts roughly
items.note: Worn synchronizers need a transmission rebuild, which costs more.

items.t: Rear hatch handle or latch panel breaks
items.job: Replace the rear hatch handle/garnish (and latch switch if damaged)
items.note: Aftermarket handle garnish kit for 2005–2010 tC about $37. CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $250; one owner paid about $300. High end of parts is based on those owner-reported totals, not an OEM catalog price.

items.t: Missing load capacity label (recall)
A/C not cooling properly
items.job: A/C leak diagnosis, repair and recharge
items.note: Diagnosis alone is about 1 hour; compressor replacement costs more.

items.t: Moonroof rattles or wind noise
items.job: Adjust moonroof and replace worn seals or deflector

items.t: Growl or rattle when releasing the clutch
Brief rattle on cold start
items.job: Reinstall or replace intake camshaft VVT gear

items.t: Check engine light with crankshaft sensor code P0335
items.note: If the camshaft gear bulletin applies, the job takes several hours more.

items.t: TRD brake kit hoses can fail (recall)
items.job: Replace TRD brake kit with standard brakes

items.t: Water on the passenger floor from a clogged A/C drain
items.note: Drying or replacing soaked carpet padding is extra.

items.t: Door lock actuator failure
Bluetooth drops or texts don't show on screen
items.job: Re-pair phone and update audio head unit

items.t: Load label doesn't count installed accessories (recall)
